name: @borjie/artifact-engine
description: The ONE unified artifact engine — promotes the portal-genui tab-widget schema to a top-level ArtifactSpec over the 35-kind genui superset, routes any artifact to a surface (inline / canvas) via a pure five-signal AND-gate, and renders every kind through the SAME PART_SCHEMAS dispatch the genui AdaptiveRenderer already uses. Reachability-complete: an unknown kind renders UnknownKindCard, never throws. ADDITIVE — sits ABOVE @borjie/genui (primitives) + @borjie/portal-genui (tab schema); does not replace either.
